messages:
maria (sre): noticed a spike of 5xxs for embeddings from eu1-dedicated, traced to a kv cache edge case. Need an expedited hotfix deploy, low blast radius but customer-visible.
releasebot: artifact built: hotfix/kv-cache-fix@v3.1.4. CI: all green. Deploy request requires 2 approvers or SRE lead override. Link: <ci/internal/job/9876>.
kevin: can we run a targeted canary first? staging smoke already running.
jordan (oncall): staging smoke passed, but synthetic tail latency is +12% under stress. Not ideal but acceptable if we keep short holds.
sara: we can keep traffic guard and immediate rollback on error budget breach. If rollout fails, rollback takes <2min.
kevin: deploybot will block if we skip canary and need SLA exemption. Ops: any objections to a 30m maintenance window to expedite? @maria
maria (sre): ops +1. rollback playbook loaded, tracing and alerts linked to the runbook. I recommend skipping extended canary — low risk and urgent customer impact.
releasebot: EXPEDITE request posted: hotfix/kv-cache-fix@v3.1.4 -> eu1-dedicated. Requires 2 approvals OR SRE lead override for canary-skip. React with :thumbsup: to approve, reply with concerns to veto.
deploybot: policy: canary-skip requires explicit approval when SLA impact > 0.2%.
kevin: :thumbsup: (approve skip)
sara: :thumbsup: (approve, monitoring in place)
releasebot: SRE lead override granted. Canary-skip and SLA exemption recorded. Release notes owner notified.
maria (sre): kicking the rollout. plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 2-minute holdpoints and metric checks at each stage.
deploybot: rollout started: step=10% image=hotfix/kv-cache-fix@v3.1.4 shard=eu1-dedicated
kevin: 10% pass, no 5xxs, token latency stable.
jordan (oncall): small pod restart at 22% step, readiness probe recovered, no user errors. continuing.
sara: 50% pass, metrics look nominal. escalating to full roll.
deploybot: step=100% complete. all pods running new image.
maria (sre): marking as complete for now. Monitoring for 15m post-deploy. Will open postmortem only if regression. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
